name: Chrono Architect
description: Manipulates execution speeds and time frequencies across the battle arena.
coopSynergyMechanism: Creates temporal acceleration bubbles that allow nearby allies to execute weapon reload and auto-logic loops up to 50% faster.
recursiveDraftFocus: Cooldown reductions, time distortion fields, faster automated loop triggers, effect duplication via temporal echo.

name: Quantum Entangler
description: Establishes spatial force lines between ships and enemy fleets.
coopSynergyMechanism: Tethers groups of enemies together so single-target damage or status effects dealt by teammates chain across all linked targets.
recursiveDraftFocus: Linking targets, chaining damage across tether networks, spatial disruption and displacement.

name: Hyper-Conductor
description: Converts internal heat and shield pressure into raw electrical power output.
coopSynergyMechanism: Siphons weapon heat generated by teammates to charge map-wide EMP lightning pulses while keeping allies cool.
recursiveDraftFocus: Heat-to-voltage conversion, high-voltage EMP discharges, overclock bursts, weapon power surges.

name: Graviton Weaver
description: Controls local gravity, singularities, and kinetic momentum forces.
coopSynergyMechanism: Pulls scattered enemy waves into dense compressed clusters so allies' AoE explosives and line beams hit 100% of targets.
recursiveDraftFocus: Clumping enemy waves, singularity fields, compression damage amplifiers, kinetic collision scaling.

name: Nanite Swarm Controller
description: Deploys self-replicating metallic bugs that consume armor and rebuild hulls.
coopSynergyMechanism: Infests enemies; when destroyed they explode into repair swarms that seek out and restore damaged teammate hulls.
recursiveDraftFocus: Self-replicating swarm scaling, armor stripping, infestation spread, passive team hull restoration.

name: Phase Weaver
description: Shifts vessel hitboxes into alternate dimensions to bypass physical threats.
coopSynergyMechanism: Triggers an emergency phase-shift field when allies take fatal damage, rendering the team invulnerable for 1.5 seconds.
recursiveDraftFocus: Phase state duration, blink repositioning, invulnerability windows, shield-drop reactive triggers.

name: Resonance Bard
description: Emits harmonic geometric frequencies that build passive stat multipliers over time.
coopSynergyMechanism: Projects a growing resonance aura that stacks movement speed, shield regen, and firing rate multipliers on clustered allies.
recursiveDraftFocus: Harmonic stack scaling, aura radius expansion, broadcast range, cross-fleet amplification.

name: Scrap Salvager
description: Collects floating wreckage to construct physical debris barriers and shields.
coopSynergyMechanism: Pulls debris into an orbiting junk belt that physically blocks incoming projectiles from hitting trailing teammates.
recursiveDraftFocus: Debris collection rate, barrier HP scaling, ricochet projectiles off debris, on-kill debris generation.

name: Vector Specialist
description: Deploys floating reflective prisms and manages geometric firing angles.
coopSynergyMechanism: Places prism mirrors that split and reflect teammates' laser beams into multi-angle, auto-aiming kill matrices.
recursiveDraftFocus: Prism count scaling, beam split multipliers, ricochet chains, mirror angle optimisation.
